items.question: What condition must be met before refuge in Śrīguru?
premises: Verse states until not comes refuge.
items.inference: Refuge in Śrīguru is the endpoint named by the verse.

items.plain_english: Until one comes to refuge in Śrīguru, who loves devotees.
